label: Main
impact: Dashboard, worker, media applications, Mira and local web tools will be unavailable until Main returns.
externalReason: Restart from Proxmox or an independent SSH session after draining the worker. This host runs the dashboard and its worker.

label: PVE
impact: All hosted virtual machines and containers will be unavailable, including Main, the database, Auth, monitoring and application hosts.
externalReason: Restart from the physical or Proxmox console after an orderly guest shutdown. This hypervisor runs the worker and database VMs.

label: DB
impact: PostgreSQL, connection pooling and pgAdmin will be unavailable. Applications using the database, including Auth and dashboard jobs, will be interrupted.
externalReason: Pause dashboard jobs and restart from an independent SSH session. The worker cannot retain job ownership while its database is offline.

label: Adguard
impact: The primary DNS node and configuration sync will be unavailable. Sentinel must answer DNS before this restart; DNS maintenance is serialized across both nodes.

externalReason: Pause and drain jobs, then restart through an independent SSH session. The worker cannot verify its own restart.

label: Database connection pool
